scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const p = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm'; spawn(p, ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); spawn(p, ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
